data.name: access.refused
data.value: Access to this was refused.
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.Refused: the database refused a save the application's own checks let through, by a policy or a guard; or a request that lets one caller or another through met neither, and its argument Reasons lists each case's code and arguments. No placeholders.

data.name: access.role-not-allowed
data.value: The role this sign-in carries gives no access here: {Role}.
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.RoleNotAllowed: a signed-in user's token carries a role the host gave no database role, so nothing ran for it. {Role} is the role the token carries.

data.name: access.not-signed-in
data.value: Only a signed-in user can do this.
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.NotSignedIn: a request requires a signed-in user, and the caller did not sign in, or is the application's own work. No arguments.

data.name: access.system-only
data.value: Only the application itself can do this.
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.SystemOnly: what only the application's own work may do, refused past the door by a use case or a handler, and the caller is a user or did not sign in. No arguments.

data.name: access.not-own
data.value: Only whoever this is about can do this.
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.NotOwn: a request is about the caller's own, a seat or a user, and names one that is not the caller's. No arguments.

data.name: access.not-found
data.value: That was not found, or it is not one you can see.
data.comment: ToolkitRefusals.NotFound: a request is about the owner of an aggregate, and names one there is no row of for the caller, whether it does not exist or row level security keeps it from the caller. No arguments.

data.name: ddd.value-invalid
data.value: {ValueObject} is not valid.
data.comment: ValidationError.UnspecifiedCode: a Validate() override refused without saying why. {ValueObject} is the type name.

data.value: '{PropertyName}' is not a valid {ValueObject}.
data.comment: MustBeValid() in DTS.DDD.FluentValidation. {PropertyName} is the property, {ValueObject} the value object type.
